name: Strong Wings
levelText: arcanist 1, bloodrager 1, druid 1, hunter 1, ranger 1, redmantisassassin 1, sorcerer 1, witch 1, wizard 1 (strix)
description: The target’s wings grow more powerful, causing its fly speed to increase by +10 feet and its maneuverability to improve by one category (to a maximum of good). This increase counts as an enhancement bonus. This spell has no effect on wingless creatures or winged creatures that cannot fly.
